 Live coverage of CAHN vs Johor Darul Ta'zim: Perea's long-range shot hits the post – a truly unfortunate miss.
 CAHN created several dangerous opportunities in front of Johor Darul Ta'zim's goal. Brayan Perea nearly scored with a decisive long-range shot, but the ball hit the post, much to the disappointment of the home team.
 Báo Lào Cai • 19/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Updates will continue... 
 GOAL 
 CAHN : Perea (3')
 OFFICIAL LINEUP 
 Johor Darul Ta'zim FC: Andoni Zubiaurre (58), Afio Fazail (4), Shahab Zahedi (7), Arif Aiman ​​(10), Shane Lowry (14), Nenê (18), Stoichkov (19), Dani Bolt (20), Brad Tapp (26), Kevin Medina (81), Marcos Guilherme (95).
 CAHN : Filip Nguyen (1), Doan Van Hau (5), Stefan Mauk (6), Jason Pendant (7), Le Pham Thanh Long (11), Hoang Van Toan (12), Damia Sabater (14), Leygley Adou (38), Alan Grafite (72), Le Van Do (88), Brayan Perea (90).
 45' 
 The first half had 2 minutes of added time.
 38' 
 Goalkeeper Filip Nguyen is playing with focus and initiative in goal. He consistently makes accurate judgments, catching balls heading towards the CAHN goal, helping to maintain the home team's advantage.
 37' 
 Medina crossed from the left wing, but Thanh Long's indecisive clearance created an opportunity for Jairo to shoot inside the penalty area. Fortunately, the Johor player's skillful shot went over the crossbar of Nguyen Filip's goal.
 36' 
 Johor Darul Ta'zim is increasing the pressure with many dangerous attacks, constantly sending the ball into CAHN's penalty area. The home team's defense is struggling to cope with the growing offensive power from the Malaysian representative.
 33' 
 Johor Darul Ta'zim FC began to push forward, intensifying their attacking options and continuously putting pressure on CAHN's goal. The Malaysian team was striving to find an equalizer, forcing the home team's defense to maintain a high level of concentration.
 28' 
 THE POST DENIED A GOAL!
 Brayan Perea nearly scored for CAHN with a decisive long-range shot. Unfortunately, the ball hit the post of the Johor Darul Ta'zim goal and bounced out. The police team continued to miss opportunities to increase their lead, much to their disappointment.
 27' 
 Johor Darul Ta'zim FC made 3 substitutions.
 20' 
 You may also like Before the second round of Group B matches in the Shopee Cup 2026/27, CAHN was ranked 3rd with 3 points and a goal difference of +1. The police team was behind Johor Darul Ta'zim (1st place, 3 points, goal difference +6) and Persib Bandung (2nd place). CAHN earned 3 points after a 1-0 victory against Lion City Sailors in their opening match.
 Damia Sabater had a one-on-one opportunity with the Johor Darul Ta'zim goalkeeper, but his shot was too weak and lacked the necessary power to beat the visiting team's custodian. CAHN unfortunately missed the chance to increase their lead.
 16' 
 THE POST DENIED A GOAL!
 Alan Grafite nearly doubled CAHN's lead with a powerful long-range shot, sending the ball straight towards the Johor Darul Ta'zim goal. Unfortunately, the ball hit the crossbar and bounced back, causing the police team to miss the opportunity to make it 2-0.
 15 minutes 
 Both teams are playing with high determination, creating a lively match. The ball is constantly being passed between the two sides with fierce challenges, showing the proactive efforts of both CAHN and Johor Darul Ta'zim in seeking opportunities.
 12' 
 Not yet! Dani Bolt broke through from the left wing into the center before unleashing a skillful shot with the inside of his right foot. However, goalkeeper Nguyen Filip accurately anticipated the situation, positioned himself well, and easily gathered the ball, preserving CAHN's advantage.
 11' 
 Immediately afterwards, Van Do and his teammates launched a lightning-fast counter-attack. Notably, the highly accurate and unpredictable through pass created an attacking opportunity for CAHN.
 Fans have every right to expect such sharp passing combinations to continue making a difference for the police team.
 10' 
 Johor Darul Ta'zim had the first dangerous attacking opportunity towards CAHN's goal. However, the visitors' shots lacked the accuracy and sharpness to make a difference.
 7' 
 CAHN continued to maintain pressure, constantly launching attacks and fiercely contesting in Johor Darul Ta'zim's half of the field, making it difficult for their opponents to build up play.
 3' 
 COME IN COME IN COME IN!!! 
 Brayan Perea, in a desperate attempt to stop the attack, inadvertently put the ball into his own net. CAHN took a 1-0 lead against Johor Darul Ta'zim!
 0' 
 FIRST HALF BEGINS!
 Johor Darul Ta'zim kicked off first.

 7:00 PM
 THE MATCH BEGINS
 7:25 PM 
 The referees and players from both teams take to the field to begin the flag-raising ceremony. 
 Match information Detail 
 The ball is rolling now. 7:30 PM, Thursday, November 19, 2026 (Vietnam time), which is 8:30 PM in Malaysia. Group B 
 Location Hang Day Stadium, Trinh Hoai Duc Street, Hanoi . Group B 
 Tournament Matchday two of Group B, Southeast Asia Club Championship – Shopee Cup 2026/27. Tuoi Tre Online 
 Watch live in Vietnam FPT Play . 
 Hanoi Police returned home after a 1-0 victory against Lion City Sailors in Singapore . Johor Darul Ta'zim arrived in Hanoi with 3 points and a goal difference of +6 after defeating Cambodian representative PKR Svay Rieng 6-0. That result put the Malaysian team at the top of Group B after the opening round, while Hanoi Police are in third place. vov.vn
 According to the Vietnam Football Federation, coach Alexandre Polking believes CAHN is capable of achieving a good result against Johor. He stated that the home team will approach the game cautiously and continue to pursue a ball-possession style of play. On the visitors' side, coach Xisco Muñoz is paying particular attention to CAHN's ability to transition between attacking and defensive phases.
 Predicted lineup: 
 CAHN : Nguyen Filip, Adou Minh, Viet Anh, Putros, Van Hau, Van Do, Stefan Mauk, Sabater, Quang Hai, Leo Artur, Alan.
 Johor Darul Ta'zim: Syihan Hazmi, Carlos Akapo, Cristian Glauder, Kevin Medina, Óscar Arribas, Dejan Petrović, Nacho Méndez, Jonathan Silva, Arif Aiman, Marcos Guilherme, Shahab Zahedi.
